# Environment

```{r}
packages <- c("tidyverse", "ComplexHeatmap", "cowplot", "grid")
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE))

set.seed(45)
Sys.info()
sessionInfo()

source("./lib/consistent_themes.R")
source("./lib/processed_data_functions.R")
source("./scripts/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/clinical_mutation_functions.R")

load_processed_data(
    "./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/curated/pathogenwatch_coverage_data.RDS",
    c(
        "isolates", "coverage_qc", "clinical_locus_coverage",
        "isolate_metadata", "locus_metadata"
    )
)

load_processed_data(
    "./data/amrsearch_10_20_2026_probes/curated/amrsearch_data.RDS",
    "gene_calls"
)
load_processed_data(
    "./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/curated/pathogenwatch_mutation_data.RDS",
    c("amr_df", "mutation_positions")
)

figure_prefix <- "./figures/s_figure_8_pathogenwatch_isolate_coverage"
dir.create(dirname(figure_prefix), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# display-only rename: rDNA -> rRNA gene (keeps raw locus IDs for matching)
rrna_display <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("16S_rDNA", "16S_rRNA_gene", x)
    gsub("23S_rDNA", "23S_rRNA_gene", x)
}

isolate_info <- isolate_metadata %>%
    transmute(
        isolate,
        sample_id,
        pool_id,
        pool_level,
        panel_title = paste0(isolate, "\nPool ", pool_id, " (", pool_level, ")")
    )
stopifnot(nrow(isolate_info) == 9, !anyNA(isolate_info$pool_id))
stopifnot(length(isolates) == 9, n_distinct(coverage_qc$locus) == 35,
          !anyDuplicated(coverage_qc[c("isolate", "locus", "locus_position")]),
          !anyNA(coverage_qc$locus_position), all(is.finite(coverage_qc$normalized_depth)),
          all(coverage_qc$normalized_depth >= 0))

# order panels by pool concentration (High -> Medium -> Low), then isolate
pool_order <- c("High", "Medium", "Low")
stopifnot(all(isolate_info$pool_level %in% pool_order))
ordered_isolates <- isolate_info$isolate[order(
    factor(isolate_info$pool_level, levels = pool_order),
    isolate_info$isolate
)]
stopifnot(setequal(ordered_isolates, isolates))

# same locus order as figure 4d
loci <- sort(unique(coverage_qc$locus))
formatted_locus_labels <- format_pathogenwatch_loci(loci)
renamed <- unname(formatted_locus_labels$renamed[loci])
ordered_loci <- loci[order(renamed)]
locus_lengths <- setNames(
    locus_metadata$locus_length,
    locus_metadata$locus
)[ordered_loci]
locus_positions <- seq_len(max(locus_lengths))
stopifnot(all(count(coverage_qc, isolate)$n == sum(locus_lengths)),
          all(count(coverage_qc, isolate, locus)$n ==
              locus_lengths[count(coverage_qc, isolate, locus)$locus]))
```

```{r}
isolate_matrices <- setNames(lapply(isolates, function(sample_name) {
    sample_data <- filter(coverage_qc, isolate == sample_name)
    mat <- matrix(
        NA_real_,
        length(ordered_loci),
        length(locus_positions),
        dimnames = list(ordered_loci, locus_positions)
    )
    indices <- cbind(
        match(sample_data$locus, ordered_loci),
        sample_data$locus_position
    )
    mat[indices] <- sample_data$normalized_depth
    stopifnot(identical(unname(mat[indices]), sample_data$normalized_depth),
              sum(!is.na(mat)) == nrow(sample_data))
    mat
}), isolates)

make_panel <- function(sample_name) {
    mat <- isolate_matrices[[sample_name]]
    called_loci <- gene_calls$locus[gene_calls$isolate == sample_name]
    panel_locus_labels <- paste0(
        gsub("_", " ", rrna_display(ordered_loci)),
        ifelse(ordered_loci %in% called_loci, " (called)", "")
    )
    ht <- Heatmap(
        mat, name = "position_depth", col = coverage_colors, na_col = "white",
        cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
        row_names_side = "left", row_labels = panel_locus_labels,
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9.5),
        column_labels = ifelse(
            locus_positions == 1 | locus_positions %% 1000 == 0,
            locus_positions,
            ""
        ),
        column_names_rot = 0, column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
        column_title = "Position (bp)", column_title_side = "bottom",
        column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
        show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
        use_raster = TRUE, raster_device = "agg_png", raster_by_magick = FALSE,
        layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
            first <- j == 1
            grid.rect(x = unit(locus_lengths[i[first]] / ncol(mat) / 2, "npc"),
                      y = y[first], width = unit(locus_lengths[i[first]] / ncol(mat), "npc"),
                      height = height[first], gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = "black", lwd = 0.6))
            marked <- markers[cbind(i, j)]
            grid.points(x[marked], y[marked], pch = 1, size = unit(1.1, "mm"),
                        gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.6))
        }
    )
    grid.grabExpr(draw(ht, column_title = isolate_info$panel_title[match(sample_name, isolate_info$isolate)],
                       column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
                       padding = unit(c(3, 2, 3, 2), "mm")), width = 5.6, height = 5.3)
}
panels <- lapply(ordered_isolates, make_panel)

# labels = "AUTO" adds panel letters A-I; remove if you don't cite panels individually
panel_grid <- plot_grid(plotlist = panels, ncol = 3)
coverage_legend <- Legend(
    title = "Chromosome-normalized depth",
    col_fun = coverage_colors,
    at = c(0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2),
    labels = c("0", "0.5", "1", "1.5", "2+"),
    direction = "horizontal",
    title_position = "topcenter",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    legend_width = unit(5, "cm"),
    grid_height = unit(2.5, "mm")
)
coverage_legend_grob <- grid.grabExpr(draw(coverage_legend))

supplement_figure <- plot_grid(
    panel_grid,
    coverage_legend_grob,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(1, 0.055)
)
```

```{r, fig.width=16.8, fig.height=15.9, dpi=120}
supplement_figure
```

Each panel shows one QC-passing isolate and its pool, with all 35 Pathogenwatch reference genes retained. Panels are ordered by pool concentration (High, then Medium, then Low). A gene is marked `(called)` only when AMRSearch reports a gene call for that isolate and reference; unmarked genes have no gene call. Each isolate is normalized by its own chromosome median-nonzero depth, matching the isolate-level normalization used by Figure 4. The common legend shows the Figure 4D color scale: white at zero, blue below 1, yellow at 1, and orange to red up to 2+, with space outside the gene blank. Circles mark database mutation positions, regardless of whether the isolate has the mutation; variants sharing a position share a circle. The four disrupted entries listed above have no defined position.
